title: City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE): floor space per space use for blocks, every census year since 2002, with five columns of unoccupied space
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset floor-space-by-use-by-block
credit: CLUE: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the dataset's metadata, license CC BY, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-05)
citation: City of Melbourne, Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE), Floor space per space use for blocks, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/floor-space-by-use-by-block/ ; definitions: https://www.melbourne.vic.gov.au/clue
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark; one row a CLUE block and a census year. Fields: census_year; block_id; clue_small_area; then the floor space (m2) of each of CLUE's 38 space uses, among them office, retail_shop, residential_apartment, commercial_accommodation, and the five unoccupied uses unoccupied_unused, unoccupied_under_renovation, unoccupied_under_construction, unoccupied_under_demolition_condemned and unoccupied_undeveloped_site; and total_floor_space_in_block. The dataset is confidentialised: a cell that pertains to two or fewer businesses is suppressed and blank, while the row's total is the true total including the suppressed cells; so a column's sum over blocks is a lower bound, and the floor space not shown in a row is the total less the sum of its cells.
coverage: The municipality, census years 2002 to 2024: 13,519 rows (543 blocks a year to 2006, 603 from 2008; checked 2026-11-05; the dataset's metadata last modified 2021-11-02, its rows extended since).

all.description: Every block of every census year (about 1.5 MB; fetch again with --refresh after the City adds a year)
